mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate crosses above 0.5% per annum, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS crosses above 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate signals economic slowdown with accommodative policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to deteriorating earnings prospects.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 410,000 million dollars, strong consumer spending supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS exceeds 410000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the prior 3 months indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.5%, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production signals broad economic contraction in housing and manufacturing sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95 (index 2017=100), it indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 95, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
